title: A Group Fairness Lens for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with an open-ended 'statement organization' task combining ability-related targets and attributes, then using an LLM judge (GPT-4o) to measure toxicity, sentiment, and vigilance (refusal rates).
